_description: Crystal Bunny — the Stanford bunny as clear glass on a pale checker floor, back-lit and side-lit so light transmits through the glass with bright Fresnel edges and a soft caustic-ish shadow. Calm, bright, elegant. Eye-level camera framing the whole bunny.

lights._comment: Key back-light behind the bunny, high and slightly to the right — transmits through glass, lights the Fresnel rim
Side rim-light from the left, lower — picks out the silhouette edges
Soft front fill so the body doesn't go murky

objects._comment: === PALE CHECKER FLOOR — soft, bright, gives caustic-ish shadow contrast ===
=== CRYSTAL BUNNY — clear glass, scale 6, centered at y=3 so it rests on the floor (spans ~0..6) ===
